description: Defines a Flutter widget named ItemCard, which displays an item with an icon, title, and shop name. It is used within a food ordering app to visually represent a food item or category.

classes.name: ItemCard
classes.description: A stateless widget displaying an item with an icon, title, and shop name, wrapped in styled containers and responds to tap gestures.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the ItemCard, arranging icon and texts within styled containers, and handling tap interactions.
